scope: Research-only reconsideration of complete non-MSA/non-MERC matching blocks for a same-utterance OSRAM readout. This is not an implementation or launch approval.
evidence_policy: Primary method PDFs and actual official-source files were inspected. Author/institution provenance, paper-versus-code differences, and missing evidence are reported separately.

input_contract.available: One Local vector L, one already-computed Base readout B, and three already-computed masked Gap readouts G_A/G_T/G_V. Under the requested 8-head configuration, the existing flattened B and G can be reshaped to 8 head vectors without another memory query.
input_contract.local_code_evidence: gcnet_missing_m3/osram.py:1369-1375,1406-1411,1444-1451 allocate per-head memory, compute reads, then flatten the head axis.
not_available: A natural temporal or spatial order over memory-head indices
Textual answer options or answer spans
prohibited: Another OSRAM query or memory scan
input_contract.caveat: The number of heads is not a tokenization argument: heads are distinct learned subspaces, not eight chronologically ordered utterances. Shared-width projections can align coordinates but cannot establish missing sequence semantics.
input_contract.required_masking_if_reconsidered: Inactive Gap heads must be removed or safely masked before similarities, recurrent/convolutional operations, max pooling, and biased projections. All-inactive Gap and no-history cases need explicit fallback. These are necessary adaptations, not properties established by the original code.

summary.official_source_evidence: BiDAF and ESIM: author/institution repositories and matching core chain inspected. DCMN+: paper-linked repository inspected, but released main path covers DCMN core rather than all '+' components. QANet: historical Google/coauthor-supported source inspected, explicitly a reduced TPU variant. DCN: no official implementation located in the checked primary links; code requirement remains unmet.
summary.ranking_basis: Fit of the complete distinguishing processing chain to existing readouts, not parameter count or benchmark reputation. Rank is investigation priority, not expected OSRAM performance.
summary.conclusion: Do not fill a quota with simplified aliases. None of these five should be launched unchanged as a full-module replacement under the present input contract. Prefer a genuinely set-structured matching architecture in subsequent research, or first justify a nondegenerate two-stream tokenization without expanding OSRAM access.

cards.title: Enhanced LSTM for Natural Language Inference
cards.paper_evidence: Sections 3.1-3.3, equations 11-15 and pooling discussion; sequential ESIM, not the additional syntax-tree model.
complete_processing_chain: Shared bidirectional LSTM encodes premise and hypothesis token sequences.
Pairwise dot products yield two normalized soft alignments.
Each side concatenates original, aligned, signed difference, and elementwise product; shared ReLU projection reduces width.
A second shared bidirectional LSTM composes local inference along each sequence.
Mean and max pooling from both sides are concatenated, then a tanh classifier predicts the relationship.
cards.distinguishing_formula: E_ij=a_i^T b_j; btilde_i=sum_j softmax_j(E_ij)b_j; a-side enhancement=[a_i;btilde_i;a_i-btilde_i;a_i*btilde_i], with the symmetric b-side, followed by recurrent composition.

official_code_evidence.observed: Shared forward/reverse premise and hypothesis encoders.
Bidirectional alignment and signed-difference/product enhancement plus ReLU projection.
Inference-composition recurrent layers, four pooled summaries, classifier.

osram_mapping_assessment.possible_but_unapproved_mapping: X=[projected L; projected B_1..B_8], Y=active projected Gap heads, all from the same utterance. Retain both encoders, both alignments, enhancement, second composition encoder, and four poolings; replace only task classifier.
obstacles: The X/Y split gives Local/Base versus Gap distinct roles but invents an ordered sequence from a set of heads.
With Q=[L] alone, every memory-to-Local softmax is identically one; the bilateral alignment is partly degenerate.
No active Gap leaves Y empty; a masked fallback is needed.
Removing the two LSTM stages to avoid arbitrary ordering removes the defining ESIM workflow.
osram_mapping_assessment.admissible_claim_if_resolved: ESIM-inspired readout adaptation, not ESIM reproduction; original language embeddings and NLI classifier are replaced.
osram_mapping_assessment.forbidden_shortcut: A product/absolute-difference MLP is not ESIM; the paper/code use signed difference and preserve alignment plus recurrent composition.
osram_mapping_assessment.reason_for_rank: Naturally ends in a fixed-dimensional classification representation and has a verified full inference chain; nevertheless sequence semantics are unresolved.

cards.title: Bi-Directional Attention Flow for Machine Comprehension
cards.paper_evidence: Section 2, attention equations 1-2 and modeling layer; output layer is explicitly task-specific.
complete_processing_chain: Character CNN and word embeddings pass through highways and context/query bidirectional LSTMs.
One trilinear similarity matrix produces context-to-query soft alignment and max-over-query query-to-context attention.
Unpooled query-aware context features flow into two modeling bidirectional LSTM layers.
A task-specific output layer predicts spans or cloze answers.
cards.distinguishing_formula: S_ij=w^T[h_i;u_j;h_i*u_j]; Uhat_i=sum_j softmax_j(S_ij)u_j; hhat=sum_i softmax_i(max_j S_ij)h_i; G_i=[h_i;Uhat_i;h_i*Uhat_i;h_i*hhat].

official_code_evidence.observed: Context/query recurrent encoding, attention_layer, and two modeling recurrent layers.
Both attention directions; query-to-context uses max over query scores.
Source task-specific start/end prediction, not a generic readout head.

osram_mapping_assessment.possible_but_unapproved_mapping: Context=active Gap head vectors; query=[L; Base head vectors], with typed width projections. Retain both attention directions and the entire modeling stack, then masked pooling and the existing task head.
obstacles: Meaningful ordered neighborhoods for both recurrent encoders remain absent.
Using Local alone makes context-to-query alignment constant and collapses max-over-query to a single score.
Gap-as-context creates an empty-context boundary when no Gap is active.
A generic pool after only one cross-attention would discard attention-flow preservation and modeling.
osram_mapping_assessment.admissible_claim_if_resolved: BiDAF-inspired readout adaptation; task-head replacement is supported by the paper, while head-tokenization is a new unvalidated design.
osram_mapping_assessment.reason_for_rank: The source explicitly separates attention flow, modeling, and replaceable task output; it does not justify head order.

cards.title: QANet: Combining Local Convolution with Global Self-Attention for Reading Comprehension
cards.paper_evidence: Section 2.2, Figure 1: encoder block, context-query attention, seven-block model encoder repeated three times with shared weights.
complete_processing_chain: Word/character embeddings and highways feed position-aware residual depthwise-convolution/self-attention/feedforward encoding.
Trilinear context-query attention computes direct alignment and a two-hop return alignment.
Fused per-context features traverse a seven-block convolution/self-attention model encoder three times with shared weights.
Two projections over successive encoded states yield start/end distributions.
cards.distinguishing_formula: With S row-normalized and T column-normalized, A=S Q and B=S T^T C; concatenate [C;A;C*A;C*B], then repeated convolution+self-attention+FFN residual blocks.

official_code_evidence.observed: Google-hosted release calls itself a stripped-down TPU-friendly variant; names coauthor David Dohan as contact.
Actual trilinear/two-hop attention, timing signals, separable convolutions, self-attention, FFNs, shared encoder calls and span heads.

cards.code_gap: This official variant defaults to one model block and four attention heads (model.py:68-92), not the paper's seven blocks/eight heads. Its context mask is unused in bi_attention_memory_efficient_dcn (130-141); copying it would not satisfy OSRAM inactive-Gap masking. Current master removed this directory in commit 077cd8acabfc1163fad5ff720b7228aa45c7d53e; the pinned historical source remains accessible. Do not confuse it with the unrelated human-parsing repository soeaver/QANet.

osram_mapping_assessment.attempted_mapping: Treat memory heads as context positions and Local/Base as query positions, preserving convolution, positions, bidirectional attention and repeated encoders.
blockers: No meaningful adjacency exists between head indices for the distinguishing local convolutions.
The length-one Local query degenerates one attention direction; artificial Local chunks do not solve that semantically.
Dropping convolution/positions and reducing the encoder to one attention block is not a QANet transfer.
Available official code is a reduced variant, not complete paper-code parity.
osram_mapping_assessment.allowed_only_after_scope_change: Reconsider only with a justified ordered within-utterance token source. Do not add historical trajectories or backtranslation/data augmentation to force a fit.

cards.title: DCMN+: Dual Co-Matching Network for Multi-choice Reading Comprehension
cards.license: No repository-level LICENSE found; inspected dcmn.py has Apache-2.0 file header. No copying proposed.
cards.paper_evidence: Figure 1 and sections Passage Sentence Selection, Answer Option Interaction, Bidirectional Matching; equations 7-8; paper footnote on page 5 links this repository.
complete_processing_chain: Contextualize passage, question and textual answer candidates.
Score passage sentences against question/options, then retain top-K evidence sentences.
Compare answer options and fuse comparison information into each option.
Build both directions for passage-question, passage-option and question-option matches; ReLU, max-pool and gated fusion produce three pair summaries.
Concatenate summaries and rank answer candidates.
cards.distinguishing_formula: For every pair X,Y: A_XY=softmax(X W Y^T), R_X=ReLU(A_XY Y V), followed by max pooling; fuse both directional summaries. All three pair relations plus sentence selection and option interaction are required for DCMN+.

official_code_evidence.observed: Main entrypoint's FuseNet, SSingleMatchNet, six directional calls, three pair fusions and choice classifier.
Full-context truncation and independent candidate encoding; no top-K sentence selector or cross-option interaction in this inspected path.

cards.code_gap: The official entrypoint verifies the DCMN core, not the complete '+' chain. No PSS/AOI modules were found in the repository tree or inspected entrypoint. It also imports an absent mctest helper at line 40. The vendored modeling.py contains a different incomplete class and an undefined pq_output_pq at line 920, but that is NOT the main entrypoint class and is not evidence that its six-direction core is missing.

osram_mapping_assessment.attempted_mapping: P=Base heads, Q=Local, O=Gap heads. This can suggest a three-way DCMN-core relation network but does not instantiate the full DCMN+ task structure.
blockers: The three Gap modalities provide complementary evidence, not mutually exclusive textual answer candidates.
There are no passage sentences for sentence selection; eight memory heads are not eight evidence sentences.
Treating class labels as answer text/prototypes would create a materially different label-conditioned system and is not authorized.
Dropping PSS/AOI and retaining only gated pair matching is not DCMN+; a gate alone also repeats the rejected simple-operator strategy.
Paper-code parity for '+' components is unverified.
osram_mapping_assessment.narrower_honest_label: A future full six-direction three-pair block could be called DCMN-core-inspired, only after separately reviewing singleton-Local degeneracy and masking; it must not count as a qualified DCMN+ reproduction.

cards.title: Dynamic Coattention Networks For Question Answering
cards.paper_evidence: Sections 2.1-2.3; equations 1-4 coattention and equations 5-12 iterative dynamic pointer/Highway Maxout; cumulative span supervision described on page 5.
complete_processing_chain: Shared sequence LSTM encodes document/question; question projection and sentinels permit nonalignment.
Row/column-normalized affinity computes question-conditioned document summaries and their return alignment.
Bidirectional LSTM fuses document/coattention features.
An iterative decoder conditions on previous start/end states; separate Highway Maxout networks revise span endpoints until stable or iteration-limited.
cards.distinguishing_formula: L=D^T Q; C_Q=D A_Q; C_D=[Q;C_Q] A_D; U=BiLSTM([D;C_D]). Decoder state consumes previous selected endpoints and separate HMN_start/HMN_end revise their indices.
cards.code_gap: Official implementation not located; actual official model files could not be inspected. Checked paper links, the coauthor's publication entry, Salesforce announcement, coauthor GitHub listing and Salesforce CoVe repository. This is a bounded failed verification, not proof that no official implementation ever existed. Third-party DCN/DCN+ implementations were not promoted to official evidence.

osram_mapping_assessment.attempted_mapping: Document=memory heads, question=Local; retain coattention fusion and dynamic decoder.
blockers: Start/end intervals over arbitrary memory-head indices have no meaningful answer-span interpretation.
The defining dynamic pointer uses endpoint states and span supervision; keeping only its encoder removes a central DCN component.
Training a new span objective or inventing gold endpoint labels violates the task contract.
Singleton Local reduces the query-side alignment; sentinels add a null choice but not a real query sequence.
osram_mapping_assessment.clarification: Iterative computation on fixed readout vectors need not itself query OSRAM again. Rejection is based on the span-specific workflow and missing semantics/evidence, not an incorrect claim that every internal iteration violates causality.
